newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria tenders to buy 12,000 tonnes of rice.
newsitem.headline: Syria tenders to buy 12,000 tonnes of rice.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs (GEZA) has issued an international tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for shipment in April, a company spokesman said on Monday.
He told Reuters March 3 was set as the final date to receive bids and confirmation would be made on March 12.
Syria is already in the market for a 12,000 tonne consignment of rice under a tender issued on January 6.
That tender set February 3 as the final date for bids, with results due on February 13.
